title: List the top 10 players taller than 180 cm whose average heading accuracy—c
question: List the top 10 players taller than 180 cm whose average heading accuracy—computed across all their attribute records—is highest, but only include players who have at least one attribute record between 2013 and 2015 with a sprint speed of 90 or higher.

prediction.sql: SELECT p.XCL_123 FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130 WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180 AND p.XCL_122 IN (SELECT pa2.XCL_130 FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2 WHERE pa2.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' AND pa2.XCL_151 >= 90) GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_123 ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_139) DESC LIMIT 10

eligibility.predicate: EXISTS (Player_Attributes.XCL_130 = Player.XCL_122 AND Player_Attributes.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31' AND Player_Attributes.XCL_151 >= 90)

measures.multiplicity_argument: one row per attribute record; AVG aggregates across all records per player

arguments.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
      AND pa2.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
      AND pa2.XCL_151 >= 90
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_123
ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_139) DESC
LIMIT 10

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
      AND pa2.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
      AND pa2.XCL_151 >= 90
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_123
ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_139) DESC
LIMIT 10

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT P.XCL_121
FROM Player AS P
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.XCL_122 = PA.XCL_130
WHERE P.XCL_126 > 180
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player_Attributes AS PA2
    WHERE PA2.XCL_130 = P.XCL_122
      AND PA2.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
      AND PA2.XCL_132 >= 90
  )
GROUP BY P.XCL_121
ORDER BY AVG(PA.XCL_138) DESC
LIMIT 10
